2. This is an application for condonation of delay of 131 days in filing the Criminal Appeal.
Considering the averments made in the I.A. the delay in filing the criminal appeal is condoned.
5. The I.A. is accordingly disposed of.

Accordingly, learned counsel for the appellant is directed to serve required number of copies of the CRLA on the learned Counsel for the State within three working days hence in order to enable him to serve notice upon the respondent no.2 through the concerned Investigating Officer regarding Petu @ Sidheswar Bindhani vs State Of Odisha & Anr on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150912104/
